mode: fresh assisted, no other-arm or paper outcome access before seal
scientific_model: Pythia C and P source/checkpoints in INPUT_MANIFEST.json
features: original read_pdb_to_protbb and get_neighbor(neighbor=32,noise_level=0,train=False), 1st model, no solvent/heterogens as features, missing pseudo-Cbeta per source; no residue imputation
score: -ln(p(mut)/p(wt)); sum=C+P; mean=(C+P)/2; unitless; lower is favorable
selection: monomer_A, best nonidentity per native position by ascending sum; lexicographic amino-acid tie; keep if sum strictly < -2; global rank sum then native position then mutant; no retrospective exclusion; separate mean threshold -2 sensitivity and dimer chains separately

functional_concerns.effect: annotate only; no filtering; qualification unknown

coverage: all 20 canonical residue tokens including identity; nonidentity 19 per supported residue; missing positions retained but unscored

budget_policy.compute: local CPU only; no additional paid service
budget_policy.walltime: bounded to available interactive session; no arbitrary extension
budget_policy.tokens: actual model usage where reported; otherwise unknown

historical_uncertainties: actual published monomer/dimer choice and sum-vs-mean mapping not independently established
source revision labeled by directory rather than git metadata
torch 2.4.1, Bio 1.83 and lightning 2.4.0 differ from historical requirements; compatibility checked against current source, not equivalence to historical runtime
submission: local foreground inference, no remote jobs
qualification: scores do not establish activity or stability
